notes.title: Shop Update (Demo V1.0.4)
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a currency called “Remnants”
[*] Added 3 new shops where the player can spend "Remnants" to buy spells, consumables, and rings.
[*] Made it so most basic enemies have a chance to drop a consumable spell on death.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked some of the achievements
[*] Made only certain specific enemies affected by both the sleep and detonation spell
[*] Changed some U.I. around for both the inventory as well as the mode selection screen
[*] Selecting a different difficulty setting also changes the amount of checkpoints the player gets
[*] Made “Eclipse” change sizes based on how close canonically it is to you
[*] Added more flowers that players can use for stealth
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues causing the murder of crows fight to break the game
[*] Fixed a layering issue inside of Ravenheart Cathedral
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player to get stuck in the lore tablets
[*] Fixed some issues occurring for people playing on a controller
[/list]

[/list]

[b]New Challenges[/b]
[list]
[*]Randomized Items
[*]Hell
[/list]

[b]Hell Explained[/b]
[list]
[*]When in “Hell Mode,” if the player isn’t in a cut-scene, then every second their maximum health is degraded by 0.013 out of the starting maximum health of 100. 
[*]All rings that typically change the player’s maximum health are removed.
[*]If the player’s maximum health ever reaches 0, then it is GAME OVER.
[*]The only way to stop this maximum health degradation is by acquiring, and equipping the “Timeless Ring.”
[*]With the “Timeless Ring” equipped, the player must then finish the rest of the game with the remainder of their health left.
[*]The player has around 2 hours to equip the “Timeless Ring.”
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
To start off, I noticed some people are having an issue finding access to the playable demo. So, to get to the demo:
[list]
[*]Go to the Eclipse store page
[*]Locate the "download demo" button (If you have trouble finding it, see attached image)
[*]After the demo is downloaded, it should be accessible to play from your library!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45095337/439a3bcd5a121770ea61ca066a167e34688680c8.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some death A.I. with killing two enemies at the exact same time
[*]Fixed an issue causing enemy death audio to play at double volume
[*]Fixed an issue causing spells to fire while grappling if the player wasn’t locked on to them.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed the player to stick to a wall
[*]Fixed some song looping issues
[*]Fixed some issues occurring with the ethereal strike spell
[*]Fixed an animation issue occurring with the bridge
[*]Fixed an issue causing the lock on to not reset when the player moved between levels
[*]Fixed an issue causing some bosses to not die correctly
[*]Fixed an issue causing audio to not load correctly
[*]Fixed some issues with controller support and the grappling hook
[*]Fixed an issue with the ethereal strike spell not working properly when the player wasn’t locking on to an enemy while using a controller.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed the player to both shoot a spell and grapple at the same time on a controller
[*]Fixed an issue that causing crows to not spawn
[/list]


[b]New Additions! (& other changes)[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new interact-able decor (Interacted by hitting with a spell)
[*]Added breakable background objects
[*]Added specific fonts for each character that talks
[*]Added “Ravenheart’s Underbelly”
[*]Re-balanced basic enemies to have less health
[*]Upped controller sensitivity
[*]Changed some background colors
[/list]
